title: Fame Fades, Nature Remains: Disentangling the Character Identity of Role-Playing Agents
reasoning: The paper includes 'Morality' as a core dimension of its 'Character Identity' benchmark. It specifically evaluates how LLMs handle characters with different moral valences, such as 'Upright' versus 'Unethical' standards, and identifies performance degradation in characters with negative social or moral natures.
